name: Vet Henrietta

intro.text: Jonathan has had every ailment you can imagine, and several no one can. I'm told by the gardener that you were seen nearby. Care to show me how you handle your team?

win: Healthy as a tortoise. That's the highest compliment I give.
after: A Seychelles giant tortoise can live for 150 years or more, and weigh over 200 kilograms. Jonathan has been checked, wormed and scolded by many vets.
